summary: Implemented unknown-total speed display in rich/progress.py: TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed (default False), a static render_speed(speed) using filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix, and a render branch for unknown totals; module-level track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track now infers total as explicit value, else len for Sized sequences, else None without raising. Updated tests/test_progress.py (removed the two ValueError assertions, added test_task_progress_column_speed) and added a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Added line. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), per instructions; changes were verified by reading only. Nothing committed.
